points.point: Does an Instagram post automatically show on Facebook Page?
points.sentence: Blotato's Instagram publisher submits to Instagram.

points.point: Will picking Facebook too cause people to see it twice (duplicates)?
points.sentence: If Instagram's native crossposting is enabled, check Facebook before sending an additional Facebook post to avoid duplicates.

verdict.reason: The entry states Blotato's Instagram publisher only submits to Instagram, and covers the duplicate risk when native crossposting is on and Facebook is also selected.
